description.p: Install packages made for other Linux distributions on atomic systems, without changing the base system. Open a package file and the Installation Wizard takes care of it.

Supported: RPM, DEB, Arch Linux, Alpine, Void, Solus, Slackware, Gentoo, Pisi, SliTaz and Puppy packages, installed with their dependencies in Distrobox containers; AppImages, with any missing libraries provided in a shared container; and snaps, without snapd.
The Application Manager is where you update and uninstall applications and adjust MultiPak's settings. It shows which applications have a newer version and updates them one by one or all at once.

description.p: Install snaps without snapd, with channel choice, updates and background services; a new review flow for AppImages; clearer dependency lists and package icons in the review; a new Application Manager with a side bar and updates listed by application.
Fix signed RPM inspection and migrate file associations and AppImage shortcuts from the old Alpha Flatpak.

Package security fixes, an updated About window, installation and unified settings in the Application Manager, and reliability fixes for cleanup after failed installations, free disk space checks and file associations.
